name: DXVK on the display GPU (session environment.d)
hostNote: gpu-195 (192.168.50.195, Bazzite 44 KDE Wayland, 2x RTX 3090; monitor on GPU0 01:00.0)
purpose: Proton/DXVK games render on the GPU that drives the monitor instead of the other identical 3090 (cross-GPU PRIME copies cost FPS). One line in the user session environment: DXVK_FILTER_DEVICE_UUID=<display GPU UUID, derived at install from the connected DRM connector -> PCI -> nvidia-smi>. A per-game launch option still overrides it; vkd3d-proton (DX12) has no UUID filter and is not covered. Podman/CDI AI containers do not inherit it.
installedBy: bash hosts/gpu-195/display-gpu/install.sh (as powos, no sudo; --dry-run shows, --remove undoes)
decide: Takes effect for Steam started after the next Plasma login (or systemctl --user daemon-reload, then a full Steam restart). Re-run the installer after moving the monitor to the other card.
